positions.stakeholder_concern: The commenter asserts that AI will make far fewer errors than human clinicians, possibly none, which in their view reduces the need for blame-assignment and for restrictive oversight.
positions.requested_fda_action: Allow generative AI substantial regulatory latitude and rely on market forces rather than prescriptive FDA requirements to constrain it.
positions.public_summary: Commenter asserts AI will make far fewer errors than humans, reducing the need to assign blame, and urges FDA to allow generative AI broad latitude with market forces, rather than regulatory requirements, providing the main constraint. No monitoring specifics offered.
positions.source_passage:
But here's the real point. AI will make far fewer mistakes than humans. Far fewer. Perhaps none at all? Then no one will have to hold anybody to blame.

How about that?

Give AI room to breathe and let market forces reign it in.
